async () => { /* B8 Space and E are inert while the board is open (no movement, no interaction) */ const p = window.player; const x = p.x, y = p.y; await window.__test.pressKey(' '); await window.__test.pressKey('e'); return window.__test.getState().activeMinigame && p.x === x && p.y === y; }

async () => { /* B8 Tab reaches every control (focus order covers every button in the board) */ const mg = window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame; const btns = [...mg.container.querySelectorAll('button, [tabindex="0"]')].filter(b => !b.disabled); const seen = new Set(); for (let i = 0; i < btns.length + 2; i++) { await window.__test.pressKey('Tab'); seen.add(document.activeElement); } return btns.every(b => seen.has(b)); }

async () => { /* B8 Esc closes with no minigame_failed */ const t = window.__test; const l = t.peekLog(200); let i = -1; l.forEach((e, j) => { if (e.kind === 'note' && e.message === 'B8 esc') i = j; }); return !l.slice(i + 1).some(e => e.kind === 'event' && e.event === 'minigame_failed') && !t.getState().activeMinigame; }
